[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part VII · Suits Relating to Tort
 Section: 83::Two years.
]


Under the Legal Representatives’ Suits Act, 1855 (12 of 1855), against an executor, an administrator or any other representative.
Period of limitationTwo years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the wrong complained of is done.
